source.comparisonMethod: Remove JSONC comments outside string literals and trailing commas, parse, then compare complete JSON objects with local brarchive entries.

coordinatePolicy.unit: game UI pixel; CSS pixel = game UI pixel * 2
coordinatePolicy.scope: Local coordinates in common.root_panel, before engine rasterization
coordinatePolicy.rounding: Preserve source floating point percentage geometry. Do not round each position, width or row height independently.
coordinatePolicy.nativeRasterizationGap: Game UI renderer pixel snapping and label baselines require a same-version game capture. JSON box equality is not a complete rendered-page equality claim.

close.source: common.common_panel controls.close_button_holder.close overrides offset to $close_button_offset, whose common_panel default is [0,0]

grindstone.emptyResult: Retains focus and hover; aria-disabled guards take callbacks when no result or invalid.

enchanting.colorSource: JSON normalized RGB defines the state colors. Opaque pixels in lossless installed Bedrock 26.60 GUI 5 screenshots confirm success #7fff1f, failure #895e5b and rune foreground #685d49; these replace the earlier nearest-8-bit estimates. Rune foreground is independently identical in all three populated rows of open and insufficient states; the empty closed rows are a negative control. This does not establish a general JSON color-quantization rule or native glyph-edge equality. See enchanting-renderer.json.runes.nativeColorEvidence for fixed PNG hashes and complete label ROIs.
enchanting.bookRenderer: custom enchanting_book_renderer, not a flat UI PNG; a caller-supplied book renderer belongs inside its source box.
enchanting.runeRenderer: font_type=rune; retain its 84x16 game-pixel box and source offsets, do not substitute a 12px English label as proof.

nativeCostShadow.scope: Three observed success rows and three insufficient-state rows; does not establish a general engine darkening formula.

sourceFacts.workstationLabels: No explicit font_size or font_scale_factor in these labels; engine defaults apply.

typography.evidenceStrength: The Mojangles file and independent 20px outline raster prove local glyph geometry at that size; they do not independently prove the native normal/rune renderer default scale or baseline.
notClaimed: Exact rune glyph shaping before the dedicated rune renderer is provided
A whole-game screenshot pixel difference of zero

verification.typecheck: npm run typecheck passed after geometry and empty-result navigation changes
verification.independentReviewer: independent_pixel_qa agent validates source math and browser boxes separately
verification.completeGameFrame: Lossless native open/closed/insufficient enchanting PNGs captured 2026-10-29; book subregion improves but remains nonzero. No whole-page native equality certification.
